name: Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Banned' 2026
story_html: The 2026 edition of the Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG 'Banned' revives the iconic colorway of the foundational sneaker in versatile low-top form. The tumbled leather upper combines a black base with Varsity Red accents on the toe box, Swoosh, heel overlay, and back tab. The latter is marked with a tonal 'X,' a design flourish carried over from the 'Banned' AJ1 High released in 2011. A woven Nike Air tag adorns the breathable nylon tongue. The sneaker is mounted on a rubber cupsole that pairs white sidewalls with a grippy crimson rubber outsole.
